title: Side-by-Side – every target of one category

list.name: category
list.label: Category (one at a time)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM smokeping.latency WHERE category NOT IN ('dns', 'cpe', 'http', 'tcp', 'unknown') ORDER BY category
list.description: One category at a time: pick it above. topsites (the top sites), netflix (the five OCA slots), custom (your own targets). The DNS Wizard's targets are not offered here, well over a hundred panels; use the DNS Wizard dashboard and Target Detail for those, and DNS resolvers have their own side-by-side under DNS.

list.name: target
list.label: Target
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target FROM smokeping.latency WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND category = '${category}' AND measurement_type <> 'dns_latency' ORDER BY target

targets.rawSql: SELECT toUnixTimestamp(timestamp)*1000 as time, avg(median_latency) as median FROM smokeping.latency WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime64($__from/1000, 3) AND timestamp <= toDateTime64($__to/1000, 3) AND target IN (${target:sqlstring}) AND category = '${category}' AND measurement_type <> 'dns_latency' AND median_latency IS NOT NULL GROUP BY timestamp ORDER BY timestamp

description: One category at a time: pick it above. topsites (the top sites), netflix (the five OCA slots), custom (your own targets). The DNS Wizard's targets are not offered here, well over a hundred panels; use the DNS Wizard dashboard and Target Detail for those, and DNS resolvers have their own side-by-side under DNS. Every target of the category on one screen, four per row: latency percentiles, mean, median and min/max envelope from ClickHouse. Click a target for every layer of it.
